about.heading: Software engineering, end to end
paragraphs: Software Engineer with {{years}}+ years of experience building software applications, solutions and platforms for clients in the USA, the UK and Colombia, from start-ups to global companies such as EPAM Systems, Perficient and Billtrust. Currently a Software Solutions Architect and Forward Deployed Engineer: designing system architecture, working directly with clients to understand how their operations run, and turning that into production-ready software, from the first MVP to launch.

Specialized in web full-stack development with a back-end focus in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript. Uses AI-assisted development with Claude Code (custom skills, hooks, agents, subagents and orchestration) and GitHub Copilot to ship faster without lowering quality.

Delivered products in travel, fintech, AI, real estate, advertising, accounting, education and e-commerce. Collaborated in distributed teams with engineers from China, Ukraine, Russia, India, Mexico, Argentina and Brazil.
focus: Solution architecture and system design, from MVP to scalable product
Working directly with clients to turn manual operations into software
Robust APIs and services with Python (FastAPI) and Node.js
Web apps with React, Next.js and Angular in TypeScript
AI-assisted development with Claude Code and GitHub Copilot
Cloud, Docker and CI/CD on AWS, GCP, Azure and Vercel

toptal.description: Toptal is an exclusive global network of freelance software developers, designers and finance experts that connects the top 3% of talent with companies for remote engagements.

billtrust.description: Billtrust is a US-based B2B fintech that automates the order-to-cash cycle. Its cloud platform streamlines invoicing, payments, cash application and collections, helping finance teams get paid faster and cut manual work.

capitol-ai.description: Capitol AI is an AI-powered platform for content creation and creativity. It helps writers, marketers and analysts generate, structure and produce long-form documents, reports and stories with large language models.

olive-tree.description: Olive Tree Holdings is a real-estate investment firm focused on multifamily and commercial property. It acquires, manages and improves communities, pairing operations with technology to support brokers, sponsors and residents.

epam.description: EPAM Systems is a global software engineering and digital product consultancy. It designs and builds large-scale products, platforms and cloud systems for enterprises across many industries, blending engineering, design and consulting.

perficient.description: Perficient is a global digital consultancy that helps enterprises modernize. It delivers digital experiences, data and cloud platforms and product engineering for clients across finance, healthcare, retail and more.

sistecredito.description: SC Computing is the software development company of SisteCrédito, a Colombian fintech offering point-of-sale installment credit (buy now, pay later) that lets shoppers finance purchases directly at merchants.

educatic.description: Educatic is an EdTech company building data and analytics tools for academic institutions. Its platforms apply machine learning to challenges like predicting and reducing student dropout, with rich visualizations and statistics.

kinesso.description: Kinesso is IPG's marketing-technology and data company, connecting media, data and technology across the agency network. Matterkind, part of the same group, focuses on addressable media activation.

marathon-oil.description: Marathon Oil was a US independent oil and gas exploration and production company. In 2024 it was acquired by ConocoPhillips. (Marathon Petroleum is the separately listed refining and marketing company.)

taxalign.description: TaxAlign is a UK-based tax and accounting services provider, helping individuals and businesses with filings, compliance and financial reporting.

cielo-travel.description: Cielo Travel is a travel company building booking and trip-management experiences, helping travellers plan, reserve and manage their journeys end to end.

evidenza.description: Evidenza is a data and AI company building intelligent, data-driven products.

cielo-travel.title: Software Solutions Architect
cielo-travel.summary: Building an internal logistics platform from scratch to automate a travel company's airport pickups and returns, which were previously managed in spreadsheets.
highlights: Designed the platform's architecture and now lead its back-end development, from MVP toward a scalable product.
Replaced manual, spreadsheet-based operations with automated workflows, consolidating scattered spreadsheets and databases into a single source of truth.
Built scheduling for airport pickups and returns and integrated Stripe, so bookings and payments now run in one system.
Work directly with the operations team as a forward deployed solutions architect, turning their day-to-day processes into product features.

toptal.title: Freelance Senior FDE
toptal.summary: Member of Toptal's top 3% network since September 2024, delivering short-term freelance contracts for Toptal clients.

evidenza.summary: Built a standalone TypeScript module that generates PowerPoint presentations from raw survey data.
highlights: Validated feasibility early with a proof of concept that reproduced the most complex slide layouts in PptxGenJS and documented the library's limits.
Built a theming system and tested core slide elements, turning every designed layout into a reusable, on-brand slide template.
Composed the templates into full presentation sections and delivered a feature-complete module, ready to plug into the client's codebase.

taxalign.summary: Added a client onboarding and checkout flow to a UK online accounting firm's Framer website.
highlights: Built a custom multi-step onboarding form inside the Framer site that captures client details and terms-and-conditions acceptance.
Automated company lookups with the UK Companies House API, so clients no longer type their company data by hand.
Connected submissions to HubSpot CRM, generated PDFs automatically and added Stripe checkout, turning the form into an end-to-end paid onboarding flow.

billtrust.title: Senior Software Engineer
billtrust.summary: Analytics reporting module for payment-processing performance, with interactive dashboards, drill-downs and PDF, CSV and XLS export.
highlights: Built interactive dashboards that give clients a clear view of payment-processing performance through metrics such as Envelope Volume and Payments Processed.
Added drill-downs from summary metrics to individual envelope and line-item matches, so users can trace any number back to its records.
Moved heavy data work into async background jobs through middleware, keeping the UI responsive on large Snowflake and MongoDB datasets.
Found and fixed bugs and performance bottlenecks, and refactored front-end and back-end code for speed and long-term maintainability.

capitol-ai.title: Software Engineer
capitol-ai.summary: AI-powered creativity platform that helps writers, artists and marketers generate ideas and create content.
highlights: Built the story/document printing feature across the UI and the AI back end, letting users export the content they generate.
Fixed bugs across the UI and the AI back end, and refactored the codebase for performance and maintainability.
Improved the platform's responsiveness and usability across devices and browsers.

olive-tree.title: Senior Software Engineer
olive-tree.summary: Platform for multi-client and tenancy brokers that auto-generates legal, financial and marketing documents.
highlights: Built a module that collects property data and feeds it into auto-generated offering memorandums and deal packages, cutting manual work for brokers.
Helped build a shared component library that keeps the platform's UI consistent.
Optimized infrastructure and CI/CD on GCP with Pulumi for more reliable deployments.

epam.title: Software Engineer
epam.summary: Modernization of the client's internal enterprise applications and infrastructure.
highlights: Successfully migrated two internal enterprise applications (Node.js/TypeScript and Angular) off legacy technology.
Migrated databases and API endpoints to Snowflake and SAP HANA, modernizing the client's data stack.
Streamlined frequent employee workflows and fixed bugs in the React and Angular front ends.

perficient.title: Mid-Level Software Engineer
perficient.summary: Console that helps Interpublic Group (IPG) clients manage audiences, syndicate content and report on performance.
highlights: Led the syndication module, owning its new implementations and support.
Rolled out a new look and feel across the app by migrating its styles with CSS and Sass.
Turned client needs into features and advised the product owner on UX.

sc-computing.title: Junior Software Developer
sc-computing.summary: SisteCrédito's software development company: payment gateway for individual customers, the company website and an e-commerce recommendation system.
highlights: Cut company costs by retiring a third-party payment gateway and integrating payment methods directly.
Helped found the Python back-end team and set its coding standards and best practices.
Built data services and a product-recommendation system for the company's e-commerce app.

educatic.title: Junior Software Developer
educatic.summary: Machine-learning platform that predicts and analyzes student dropout, from country level down to individual students.
highlights: Built the dropout-prediction software with scikit-learn, backed by multi-database data services.
Deployed and maintained web apps and APIs on client infrastructure, and streamlined Python deployments across environments.

freelance.title: Freelance Software Developer
freelance.summary: Web applications and APIs for academic-sector clients.
highlights: Developed a curricular-management web app with modules for the academic calendar, configuration and administration.
Implemented MEVN and MERN architectures for client projects, and documented database models in Oracle Data Modeler.
